tasks.title: Drinking Cup
tasks.instruction: Follow the printed diagram to fold a drinking cup. Start with the diagonal fold, fold side corners to opposite edges, fold the front top flap down over the front, turn over, and fold the back top flap down over the back.

tasks.title: Fortune Teller
tasks.instruction: Follow printed steps 1 through 3: pre-crease both diagonals and open, fold all four corners into the centre point, turn over, and fold all four corners into the centre point again.
